{{Top|leg}}
A '''Sith Tyro''' was an apprentice of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who had not yet been chosen to become a formal [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]- which can be considered roughly equivalent to the Jedi rank of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]].<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>
